summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release dated September 3, 2026, announcing that its CEO, David Stamler, will present at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference 2026 via a fireside chat on September 11, 2026. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is involved; the filing is a routine investor-conference notice and forward-looking company description. The registrant is a clinical-stage biotech developing ATH434 for multiple system atrophy and is not engaged in any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, or similar event. At most this is a conference participation announcement with no deal terms to report.
